items.notes: Seasonal, not a regular service. Three June 2024 reports (Daily Star Bangla, risingbd, TBS) list Joypurhat among the Motijheel-depot routes for Eid-ul-Azha (13-18 June 2024). In April 2023 (Eid-ul-Fitr) Joypurhat was on the Joarsahara depot list. No Joypurhat stop, counter, phone, departure time or fare was published, and none for 2025 or 2026 was found. No regular BRTC depot or route in Joypurhat was found; brtc.gov.bd is robots-blocked. Confidence is medium, not high, because the information is seasonal and from 2024.

searched_but_not_found: PASSPORT: No address, phone or hours for a Joypurhat regional passport office was found. passport.joypurhat.gov.bd, dip.gov.bd and joypurhat.gov.bd are robots-disallowed. epassport.gov.bd is a JavaScript app with no readable office list. Cybo's Joypurhat 'visa-and-passport-office' category lists only travel agents and offices in other districts. Bangla/English news searches found only other districts' passport offices. The only Joypurhat mention found is a 2013 Daily Star report (thedailystar.net/news/deal-inked-to-build-33-passport-offices) listing Joypurhat among districts slated for a new passport office building, so no passport record was added. Online applications are at https://www.epassport.gov.bd.

PROBASHI: No Wage Earners' Welfare Board desk for Joypurhat was found. No phone or hours for TTC Joypurhat was found, and DEMO Joypurhat is confirmed only by a Cybo listing. bmet.gov.bd (old and new site), wewb/probashi gov.bd portals and ttc.joypurhat.gov.bd (except one English page) are robots-blocked.

COACHING CHAINS: Only Udvash-Unmesh lists a Joypurhat branch. retinabd.org/branches lists 33 branches with none in Joypurhat (Rajshahi division: Rajshahi, Bogura, Pabna, Naogaon, Sirajganj). mentors.com.bd and acsfutureschool.com show no Joypurhat branch, and Biddabari is online-only. Saifur's (saifurs.com), UCC (uccbd.net; uccbd.com is an unrelated construction firm), Fahim's (fahimsbd.com), Oronno (oronno.com) and Psychology (psychologymedical.com) are robots-blocked, so they were not checked.

LOCAL COACHING: Web searches for Joypurhat coaching centres returned nothing local; all local entries come from Cybo's educational-institution list (36 results, only 25 readable; pagination did not load). Left out: 'Student's Care Teaching Academy coaching center' (listed with postal code 5259, which is not Joypurhat) and 'Arif Private Centre' (unclear what it is). Cybo 'tutoring-service' for Joypurhat lists only non-Joypurhat places.

IT: The government Joypurhat Polytechnic Institute's short courses were not found (gov.bd portal blocked). From Cybo, 'Jumman Computer' and 'Magic Academy' are marked permanently closed and were skipped. Also skipped: 'AR It Institute' and 'E training centre' (no phone, only the generic town-centre plus code), 'NDC technical, hatil campus' (type unclear) and 'Real Life School' (type unclear; its site is robots-blocked). 'Income Varsity' and most other entries on Cybo's computer-training page are in other districts.

LIBRARY: No upazila public libraries (Akkelpur, Kalai, Khetlal, Panchbibi) were found; Cybo has no library pages for those upazilas, and Banglapedia gives only counts (Sadar: 'Library 11'). Several 'library' listings in Joypurhat town are bookshops or stationers and were left out: Titas Library, তিতাস লাইব্রেরী এন্ড পেপার হাউস, New Iqra Library, Oxford Library and Photocopy, আজিম বুক হাউজ, Joypurhat Siddiqa Kutobkhan Library, and the ambiguous Niribili library. 'Mujibur Rahman Chishti Memorial Library' (5W2P+9WW) was left out because its location is unclear.

WIFI: An ISPAB member search found only KT Computer & Network. BTRC's licensed-ISP list is on a blocked gov.bd site. Cybo has no Joypurhat ISP category page, and its telecom page lists only mobile-operator service centres. db-ip.com geolocates some Fiber@Home and Digi Jadoo IP addresses to Joypurhat, but IP geolocation is not evidence of an office, so neither was added. A Bangla Outlook report (16 Oct 2025) says Starlink's distributor Fellocity launched a free service in Joypurhat, with no location or terms, so it was not added. No national ISP coverage page was checked for Joypurhat POPs.

BRTC: No regular BRTC route, depot, counter, timetable or fare for Joypurhat was found (see the brtc record). The Eid special service for 2025/2026 was not confirmed; an Ittefaq article could not be fetched.
